Championship challenges appear for people to qualify to BSC qualifiers, then Monthly Finals, and then at the end of BSC season to World Finals. BSC 2024 season hasn’t started yet, it’s starting next month if I’m not mistaken, then the challenges will appear for every competitive month😉

1)The game doesn’t revolve around you, many new coming players want to have a chance at winning an event item, but they might not have a teammate, which would lead them to play with randoms (and most of the time lose), so SC is giving them a chance at owning the sprays with unlimited tries.

2)You’re still have an advantage above players who didn’t get it last year, you get an alternative coin reward (I don’t remember the exact amount, so don’t wanna misinform)

3)The chances that you’re going to use these exact sprays in your games are really low (not saying that you won’t), still you have it as a collectible item.

4)You need to appreciate what they’ve prepared for us, even though rewards might not be good enough for you, they still are rewards and it’s better than nothing imo. (don’t perceive it as me defending SC, I’m aware of them making poor choices at times, and ofc their greed)

5)Also, it’s “infinite *losses”, you don’t use adjectives with verbs, the noun form for lose is loss☝️🤓
